About the Brand

Built for India's
Toughest Walls

Asian Paints SmartCare is India's dedicated waterproofing sub-brand — engineered to fight the country's most relentless enemies: humidity, seepage, saltwater corrosion, and structural cracks. With warranties ranging from 3 to 12 years across its range, SmartCare's elastomeric formula doesn't just coat walls — it bridges cracks, blocks dampness, and outlasts the monsoon.

As the fastest-growing challenger in Kerala's waterproofing market, SmartCare commands 25–28% market share and is uniquely positioned to leverage Asian Paints' deep dealer network to dominate the coastal segment.

Why Coastal Kerala

The Perfect Storm
of Opportunity

Coastal Kerala's climate creates a perpetual, unavoidable demand for waterproofing. Saltwater corrosion, backwater seepage, and back-to-back monsoon seasons make SmartCare not just a product — but a necessity.

🌊

Chronic Demand

Coastal humidity and relentless monsoons create year-round waterproofing urgency. Kerala's dual monsoon cycle (Edavappathy + Thulavarsham) means homes are under constant threat.

🧂

Salt-Air Corrosion

Saltwater spray from the Arabian Sea causes Efflorescence — the white powdery peeling unique to coastal homes. It's a Kerala-exclusive, high-urgency problem competitors rarely address.

📋

Regulatory Push

Kerala and Tamil Nadu regulations now mandate certified waterproofing products in new construction, creating a legislative tailwind for trusted brands like SmartCare.

Target Cities

Three Cities.
One Strategy.

Kollam
Homeowners · Contractors

High density of independent houses makes it the prime market for DIY and contractor-led waterproofing. Focus on roof/terrace protection during peak pre-monsoon season. The traditional heartland.

Kochi
Apartments · Commercial

Urban owners prioritize "preventative luxury" to protect high-value coastal assets. Address complex seepage in vertical structures and premium real estate across Ernakulam, Fort Kochi & Kakkanad.

Varkala
Airbnb · Resorts · Stays

Cliff-side stays face brutal salt-air exposure. Pitch waterproofing as "Business Insurance" — one bad monsoon season means negative reviews, refunds, and structural damage.

The May Advantage

Hit 2–4 Weeks Before
Monsoon Arrives

May is the maintenance window — after tourist season, before the monsoon shutdown. It converts "pre-rain anxiety" into immediate sales action. This campaign launches exactly at the psychological breaking point of every Kerala homeowner.

Who We're Talking To

Target Group &
Psychographics

SmartCare's Kerala campaign speaks to five distinct audience types — each with different motivations, trust signals, and purchase triggers. Understanding each one shapes every creative and media decision.

🏠
Vikram
Coastal Homeowner
Age 30–45

"Seepage is a failure of my home's dignity — I need one permanent solution, not patches."

Anxious after every monsoon. Compares notes with neighbours and trusts word-of-mouth above specs. Mid to premium house segment. Views his home as a reflection of his status — won't accept recurring maintenance.

Quality Seeker Loss Averse Brand Loyal
🔍
Meera
Young Homebuyer
Age 25–35

"I just bought my first flat — show me the warranty, the coverage, the proof. I need to know this works."

New flat in a coastal city. Paranoid about hidden defects she didn't catch during purchase. Researches obsessively on YouTube and Instagram before deciding. Prefers solutions she can articulate and validate.

Research-Driven Instagram User Proof Seeker
🔧
Rajan
Civil Contractor
Age 30–50

"My reputation is my livelihood. When I recommend something, complaints come back to me. I only recommend what I trust fully."

Manages 8–20 projects per year. Favours brands with strong dealer networks, consistent supply, and generous margins. Loyal once convinced — a key multiplier in the trade channel with strong downstream influence.

Reputation-Driven Trade Channel Repeat Buyer
🖌️
Dinesh
Independent Painter
Age 25–45

"Whoever makes my job easier, pays on time, and treats me well — that's whose product I'll recommend at the wall."

Recommends at point of application. Cares about ease of use, workability, and drying time. Influenced by contractor and dealer both. Brand loyalty shifts toward whoever treats him well — a critical last-mile node in the distribution chain.

Influencer Node Ease-Focused Margin Sensitive
🏨
Coastal Businesses
Airbnbs · Resorts · Hotels · Stays

Hospitality operators in Varkala, Kochi, and Kollam who understand that one monsoon-related bad review costs more than an entire waterproofing job. For them, SmartCare is business insurance — not a maintenance expense. May is their pre-monsoon action window before the June shutdown.

Online Campaign

Digital Strategy —
Coastal Kerala Focus

Problem-first, vernacular storytelling. Own the pre-monsoon conversation in Malayalam, with precision geo-targeting across Kochi, Varkala, and Kollam.

Strategy

Content Pillars

01

Before/After Transformations

Dramatic wall transformation stories from heritage villas in Kochi, cliff-side stays in Varkala, and lake-front homes in Kollam. Real homes, real results, real Malayalam voices.

Visual Storytelling
02

Education-First Content

"Why Kerala's red-brick walls crack faster" reels, explainer carousels on salt-air crystallization, and myth-busting local "jugaad" waterproofing methods. Position SmartCare as the coastal expert.

Trust Building
03

Seasonal Urgency Series

"Is your Kochi home monsoon-ready?" peaks in April–May, pegged to Edavappathy and Thulavarsham rain patterns. Convert pre-rain anxiety into immediate purchase decisions.

Conversion Driver
04

Contractor Voices & UGC

First-person Malayalam content from local maistries. "Why I trust SmartCare for Kollam's lake-side homes." Real UGC from Nalukettu home owners who stayed dry despite heavy rain.

₹2.5L
🎮
In-Game Ads
₹2L
5% of digital budget

Why it works for our TG: Kerala's 30–50 homeowner demographic plays casual mobile games daily — Ludo King alone has 500M+ downloads with deep Tier 2/3 India penetration. These are exactly the people sitting idle during commutes or evenings, making it the perfect moment to surface a "is your home monsoon-ready?" message. The medium is low-clutter, high-frequency, and reaches users in a relaxed, receptive state.

Ludo King — ₹75,000

Network: Google AdMob + InMobi  ·  Format: Rewarded video (best performer)
Rate: CPM ₹60–₹150  ·  Reach: Massive Tier 2/3 India, 500M+ downloads
Why: Highest volume, lowest entry cost — ideal for mass awareness among homeowners

₹75K
Candy Crush (King) — ₹75,000

Network: King's own network + Meta Audience Network  ·  Format: Video + banner
Rate: CPM ₹100–₹250 (premium, urban-skewed audience)
Why: Reaches Meera (young urban homebuyer) — slightly older, premium mobile gamer demographic

₹75K
8 Ball Pool (Miniclip) — ₹50,000

Network: AdMob + Unity Ads  ·  Format: Interstitials (perform best here)
Rate: CPM ₹80–₹180  ·  Profile: Male-heavy, 18–35 age group
Why: Targets Rajan (contractor) + Vikram (homeowner) — real-money gaming adjacency signals disposable income

₹50K

Kirana & Hardware · Ongoing

Vendor Loyalty Program

Local Kirana and hardware vendors receive discounted rates for bulk purchases of SmartCare products. A loyalty points system rewards vendors based on the number of successful waterproofing projects they facilitate — turning every sale into a relationship.

The Offer
Discounted bulk rates + loyalty points per successful project facilitated
Objective
SmartCare becomes the default "first recommendation" at the retail counter
Why it works
Painters and contractors trust dealer recommendations above all else. When the dealer actively pushes SmartCare and earns from it, the recommendation becomes genuine — not a scripted pitch.
